theorems.name: Submission.gwe_lipschitz_graph_area_formula
theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (K : ℝ≥0) (R : ℝ), LipschitzOnWith K f (closedBall 0 R) → ∀ A : Set (Rn n), MeasurableSet A → A ⊆ closedBall 0 R → ∀ g : Amb n ℓ → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ y in q '' graphOver f A, g y ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) = ∫⁻ x in A, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.det ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ f x (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (fderiv ℝ f x (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ)))))) * g (q (graphPoint x (f x)))
